conditionalConstantCompiler.contract: A successful conditional stage derives exactly one constant-bank-finite-f32-v1 record, stage-local slot zero, matching vsconst0/fsconst0 and the validated declared extent. conditionalConstantCompiler.facts: The existing 12-byte lane fact separates numeric access, ordinary-output authority and finite-bank dependency. Exact MOV/swizzles retain facts. Mixed UCMP keeps synchronized raw payload and numeric snapshot; any potentially selected conditional-only arm blocks ordinary output authority until actual numeric arithmetic computes a result. Known selectors retain only the selected fact. Integer/bitwise writes discard numeric provenance unless independent known-bit proof suffices.
conditionalConstantCompiler.numericDomain: Finite includes positive/negative zero and subnormal binary32 encodings. Raw-u32 storage and selection preserve their bits. conditionalConstantCompiler.proof: Native ASan/UBSan with full-result compatibility and retry/recovery checks; native/Wasm single/pair parity; actual compiler to decoded SET_CONSTANT_BUFFER to shared sync/async GPU draws; independent whole-frame bitplane and rational numeric oracles; emitted-contract and numeric-index source faults; retained shader/consumer regression oracles; exact-source final recording, pristine clone and fresh critic.

conditionalConstantConsumer.rawDomain: Each u32 in the active uploaded prefix has exponent bits unequal to 0x7f800000. Positive and negative zeros and subnormals are finite and remain bit-identical in the raw channel. This is not a numeric subnormal-preservation claim.
conditionalConstantConsumer.restore: Non-draw restoration skips incomplete or nonfinite conditional uploads while preserving command-prefix CPU state. Unconditional restoration retains its previous temporary zero defaults. A conditional DRAW always requires the complete current bank.

rawEquality.semantics: Undecorated FSEQ is ordered equality; FSNE is unordered inequality. Both zero signs compare equal; every NaN, including identical signaling payloads, compares unordered. Exact zero/all-ones raw masks use integer encodings without floating conversion.

rawShaderBoundary.acceptance: make verify-E6-T12e4a, make verify-E6-T12e4b and make verify-E6-T12e4c1; authored both-stage raw32 reconstruction with actual WebGL2 transform feedback and32 fragment bitplanes, mixed v5/v1/v2/v3 interpolation, native/Wasm parity, exact unaffected prior results and unchanged12/19 original acceptance.
rawShaderBoundary.constants: Existing uvec4 declaration metadata, VirglBlock layout and finite float-bit guest command transport remain unchanged. Direct arbitrary host uniforms are hardware probes only.
rawShaderBoundary.floatInterface: Existing attribute/varying/POSITION/COLOR ABI remains float. MOV input origins may pass through directly; raw output must prove finite normal or zero using conservative known bits. No NaN/Inf/subnormal raw-payload promise across float IO.
rawShaderBoundary.integerOutputProof: In v1/v2/v3, constant-only arithmetic/comparisons yield exact known bits. UCMP chooses a statically determined arm, otherwise intersects known bits and retains float origin only when both payload origins match. No arithmetic float-origin shortcut or arbitrary float-origin join. V4 ordinary-float authority is separately specified in numericShaderBoundary.
rawShaderBoundary.integerSemantics: UADD wraps modulo2^32. ISGE compares signed two’s-complement values; USEQ/USNE compare raw words. Comparisons produce0xffffffff or0. UCMP chooses src1 for any nonzero condition, src2 for zero, preserving private payload bits and reading all three initialized sources before writes.
rawShaderBoundary.limits: All v5 limits remain:179 non-END instructions,118 TEMP registers,46 guest constants,8 other-bank entries/immediates,16KiB text,8192 tokens,256 lines,512-byte lines,64KiB GLSL,147456/295936-byte JSON buffers,16MiB fixed Wasm,256KiB stack.
rawShaderBoundary.mixedPrograms: ADD/MUL/MAD and fragment 2D FLOAT TEX combine with raw operations under the v4 numericShaderBoundary. DIV/MAX/FRC/LRP and typed numeric source negation extend this under componentShaderBoundary. Other modifiers, PRECISE and control flow remain unsupported. Raw SAMP/SVIEW declarations without a validated mixed numeric program remain rejected.
rawShaderBoundary.orderedSemantics: Pure unsigned-word binary32 classification and ordering. Every signed quiet/signalling NaN is unordered; both signed zeros compare equal; negative magnitude order reverses; infinity and subnormal encodings retain their order. Results are exactly0xffffffff or0 without converting raw source words to floats.
rawShaderBoundary.pairing: Per-stage backend selection preserves semantic/mask/interpolation-derived keys, exact standalone fragment output, and checked smooth/flat vertex qualifiers. No caller-selected keys or backend flags.
rawShaderBoundary.scope: Isolated compiler boundary; no production guest GPU negotiation or desktop performance claim.
rawShaderBoundary.selection: Internal only after full validation. AND/OR/NOT/SHL/USHR select raw-bits-v1; UADD/ISGE/USEQ/USNE/UCMP select raw-bits-v2; FSLT/FSGE select raw-bits-v3 for that stage. Inputs without a newly supported opcode retain exact prior acceptance, errors and complete GLSL/metadata. A validated ADD/MUL/MAD/TEX in an owned raw stage selects raw-bits-v4; pure legacy numeric shaders remain v5. Validated DIV/MAX/FRC/LRP or numeric source negation selects owned raw-bits-v5, separately from legacy straight-line-v5.
rawShaderBoundary.storage: Bounded owned IR and highp uvec4 private TEMP storage; all checked UINT32 immediate words are preserved. Shift counts are masked with31. Consumed lanes are read before partial destination writes.

scalarShaderBoundary.acceptance: make verify-E6-T12e6; actual native/Wasm results, independent GPU exact/rational oracles, explicit predecessor compatibility and pristine-clone proof.
scalarShaderBoundary.authority: Retain ordinary IN, computed/sample shadow and statically proved finite-normal/signed-zero raw authority. No new magnitude, positive-value, finite-value or divisor admission guards. Unknown raw numeric CONST remains separately gated.
scalarShaderBoundary.bounds: Reserve the validated-negation opcode-mask bit 21. Keep 112-byte instructions, 26232-byte IR and existing text/instruction/register/GLSL/JSON/Wasm capacities.
scalarShaderBoundary.compatibility: Exactly two historical valid DP3 negatives are explicitly promoted with source-bound adjacent replacements. Malformed two-source RCP/RSQ cases retain complete errors. All 19 full original results remain unchanged at 12 accepted / 7 unsupported.
scalarShaderBoundary.consumption: Shared initialization/authority masks: DP3 xyz, RCP/RSQ x after swizzling. Destination masks do not redefine scalar source consumption. Typed negation precedes evaluation; aliased sources use pre-write values.

operations.DP3: dot(src0.xyz,src1.xyz), using post-swizzle lanes; replicate one scalar result
operations.RCP: 1/src0.x, using the first post-swizzle lane; replicate one scalar result
operations.RSQ: inversesqrt(src0.x), using the first post-swizzle lane; replicate one scalar result

scalarShaderBoundary.oracleBoundary: Exact dyadic dot witnesses; quantitative positive-divisor reciprocal witnesses with 2.5 ULP enclosures; positive-normal inverse-root witnesses with integer-derived rational brackets widened by 2 ULP. Computed zero signs and undefined exceptional payloads are not fixed by the oracle. These witness domains do not limit shader admission.
scalarShaderBoundary.ordinaryContract: DP3 inherits ordinary ESSL arithmetic latitude; RCP uses ordinary division, RSQ ordinary inverse square root. PRECISE, absolute, saturation and LEGACY_MATH_RULES remain unsupported; no clamp or special-input replacement.
scalarShaderBoundary.scope: Isolated ordinary scalar compiler proof only; numeric-constant contracts, production guest graphics, Mesa and MIPS claims remain gated.
scalarShaderBoundary.sourceContract: Mesa 26.2.2 TGSI documentation, interpreter, opcode metadata and source-use rules establish scalar RCP/RSQ and xyz DP3. The old pinned VirGL componentwise RCP shortcut is not used. Both captured RCP sources are explicitly xxxx.

selectedInterpolation.definedness: Initialization masks remain intersected. True-predecessor facts live only in a compact separate certificate. Guarded LRP kills its old logical destination definition and guards all arithmetic and raw/float publication; only the exact final selected use may borrow the result fact. No zero fill or zero-times-undefined rule.
selectedInterpolation.evidence: make verify-E6-T12f2: full retained stage/pair outcomes, all masks/aliases/nested predecessors, literal definition-version/demand traces, shared renderer hardware words/pixels, actual guard/width compiler faults and final exact-head cold clone.
selectedInterpolation.profiles: Existing structured8 and finite-bank9; no metadata or guest capability change.
selectedInterpolation.proof: The missing-payload predecessor has known signed-zero width. Ordered positive finite bounds force literal zero weight there; unchanged FSNE and final UCMP discard the full LRP result. Predicate, payload, fallback and destination lane versions are checked.
selectedInterpolation.reject: Second graph, missing selected lane/predecessor, nonzero missing width, reversed/changed selector, weight/fallback clobber, overlapping fallback publication, unconditional later result read, unsupported syntax or PRECISE.
selectedInterpolation.scope: One alpha-renamable outer ELSE/weight/LRP/FSNE/final UCMP family; isolated compiler/shared renderer only. PRECISE, the radial TEMP2.x gap, guest graphics negotiation and desktop300MIPS remain gated.

structuredConditionals.bounds: One validation-owned heap arena with 8 single-predecessor snapshots, capped at 53248 bytes and freed on every success or failure. Instruction, IR and profile layouts are unchanged; maximum 179 non-END instructions, fixed 16 MiB Wasm memory and 256 KiB stack.
structuredConditionals.compatibility: All 3151 predecessor single cases, 221 pairs and 19 original captured shaders retain their full results. Captured PRECISE and one-sided initialization gaps remain rejected; no original body is rewritten to claim admission.
structuredConditionals.contracts: Raw-v7 and raw-v9 both require the existing exact stage-local finite constant-bank record. Raw-v8 rejects such a record. Missing, unknown or inconsistent contracts fail before native shader allocation; current-bank validation and immutable uploads are unchanged.
structuredConditionals.initialization: Both syntactic predecessors must establish each later consumed lane. No predicate correlation, constant-branch elimination or implicit temporary initialization is used. A no-ELSE branch joins against entry state.
structuredConditionals.joins: Each authorized structured write materializes its actual numeric value in the destination physical shadow. Initialized lanes and ordinary-output authority intersect at joins; surviving numeric finite-bank dependencies combine by union. Raw words and pre-write aliases remain distinct from numeric shadows.
structuredConditionals.predicate: The post-swizzle x lane is an unsigned 32-bit word compared with zero. Noncanonical integer true values remain true; other source lanes do not affect the test.
structuredConditionals.proof: Full sanitized native/Wasm parity and allocation recovery; literal nested branch, per-lane color and word-atlas GPU results through decoded sync/async commands; independent exact numerical/reference interpretation; actual compiled polarity and written-mask-union faults; exact-source pristine-clone recording and fresh critic.
structuredConditionals.scope: Authored structured shader support in the isolated compiler/shared renderer. No PRECISE, indirect addressing, loop or original rejected Mesa admission; production guest GPU negotiation remains disabled.
structuredConditionals.syntax: Owned UIF, ELSE and ENDIF only, complete balanced structure, maximum depth 8. Optional UIF targets name the matching ELSE or ENDIF; optional ELSE targets name the matching ENDIF. No arbitrary jumps, IF, CONT or loops.
